description: This file defines a React functional component named UploadModal that provides a modal dialog for uploading ticket stub images along with event details such as name, date, location, type, and notes. It manages local state for the image preview and form data, and interacts with application context to add a new ticket stub upon submission.

methods.name: UploadModal({ onClose })
methods.description: React functional component for rendering a modal to upload and input ticket information.

methods.name: onFile
methods.description: Handles file input change, reads the selected image file, and updates the image preview state.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Updates the form state with provided key-value pairs.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Validates form data and invokes addStub with the new ticket data, then closes the modal.
